item.description: Good morning, Naresh! It's Monday, May 4th, 2026, and a beautiful autumn day here in Sydney as we kick off another week with your Daily Drive. We're looking at a sunny 23 degrees, perfect for enjoying a coffee on your commute, and a quick check shows no major disruptions on the roads or rails this morning. Did you know that today marks the anniversary of the first successful human-powered flight in Australia back in 1974? May your week take off just as smoothly – let's make it a great one!
